rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent of “occasionally” or “sometimes.”

example.jyutping: jau5 si4 ngo5 wui5 zi6 gei2 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something happens only now and then rather than regularly.

example.jyutping: gaan3 m4 zung1 keoi5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this for relatively infrequent occurrences, with a stronger “once in a while” feel than 有時.

example.english: We only occasionally get together for a meal.
example.traditional: 耐唔耐我哋先會約埋食飯。
example.jyutping: noi6 m4 noi6 ngo5 dei6 sin1 wui5 joek3 maai4 sik6 faan6
